svg.title: Beneath the Sound
svg.desc: Conceptual fitted network under the Sound. At opening the Outer Sill drives a fitted trunk between the Orren donor shelf and the Verran lower berths. Historical and emergency branches are shown separately. See the right-hand key.
svg.text: Fitted stone, shore heads and the route of the opening draw
The loaded collar enters Orren’s low shelf.
The trunk gives Verran recurring lift.
Tide mills drive five jacks and the reserve.
Relief head beneath a wash bench.
Relief head on the drying apron.
Occupiers refuse. Crews pin this head shut.
Gate gearing has its own drive. The seawall
stands on its footings as the harbor trunk
bleeds down. Keld supplies machined collars.
Fittings follow connected stone. Lines show which shores connect; their seabed alignments are schematic.
